newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen, Krupp to return to trade.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen, Krupp to return to trade.

text.p: Shares in German steel group Thyssen AG and engineering group Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch Krupp will resume normal trading on Wednesday after Krupp launched a takeover bid for Thyssen shares, the Frankfurt bourse said.

Thyssen and Krupp had been suspended pending the announcement of the 435-mark ($257) per share offer, which Thyssen said it would consider carefully. Thyssen advised its shareholders not to act on the offer.
Both shares will be traded both in IBIS electronic trade and in floor trading.
Thyssen closed Monday's electronic trade session at 344.50 marks but was quoted as high as 410 marks in unofficial trade on Tuesday.
Krupp shares were little moved in unofficial trade, dealers said. They closed IBIS trade on Monday at 270 marks.
